scope: Read all 26 passages, overviews, periods, endings and identity notes. Seven selected root checks across 16 works.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct Guatemala archaeology symposium paper confirms Iximche founding range, western confederation versus independent eastern Chajoma' communities, 1493 Tuquche' revolt, Spanish alliance in 1524 and resistance at least to 1535.
Direct Penn Museum excavation account confirms Great Palace domestic finds, including grinding stones, obsidian knives, tortilla griddles and kitchen vessels.
Direct Penn Libraries catalogue confirms 50 leaves, probable 1619-1650 copy and family/village entries dated 1586-1619.
Direct Brinton edition gives exact Haok ki xoh pax pa tinamit vae heading and How We went forth from the City translation before paragraph 155.
Direct Inter-American Commission account gives Treaty of Managua 1860 self-government provisions and 1894 incorporation.
Direct 2007 URACCAN paper page 36 distinguishes wina for meat/body and winá for from and describes community speech research.
Direct NMAI catalogue confirms carved wooden Miskito canoe-paddle model/miniature collected on Río Coco in 1924; card avoids assigning toy function.

limits: Nine other works were not independently reopened. Agent handoff and source-map contain locators and access limits. This is a bounded review, not full historical certification.
The 1492-1500 map windows do not cover the later Kaqchikel manuscript or Miskito royal/autonomy evidence; cards label these as later context.
